mustSee.title: The Dark Knight
mustSee.overview: Batman raises the stakes in his war on crime. With the help of Lt. Jim Gordon and District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman sets out to dismantle the remaining criminal organizations.

mustSee.title: Inception
mustSee.overview: Cobb, a skilled thief who steals valuable secrets from deep within the subconscious during the dream state, is offered a chance to have his criminal history erased.

mustSee.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
mustSee.overview: An apocalyptic story set in the furthest reaches of our planet, in a stark desert landscape where humanity is broken, and almost everyone is crazed fighting for the necessities of life.

topRated.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
topRated.overview: A listless Wade Wilson toils in civilian life. But when his homeworld faces an existential threat, he must reluctantly suit-up again with Wolverine.

topRated.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
topRated.overview: Godzilla and Kong must reunite against a colossal undiscovered threat hidden within our world.

mustSee.title: Titanic
mustSee.overview: 101-year-old Rose DeWitt Bukater tells the story of her life aboard the Titanic, and how she met Jack Dawson.

mustSee.title: Superbad
mustSee.overview: Two co-dependent high school seniors are forced to deal with separation anxiety after their plan to stage a booze-soaked party goes awry.

topRated.title: Kung Fu Panda 4
topRated.overview: Po is geared up to become the Spiritual Leader of the Valley of Peace.

mustSee.title: The Shawshank Redemption
mustSee.overview: Framed in the 1940s for the double murder of his wife and her lover, upstanding banker Andy Dufresne begins a new life at the Shawshank prison.

mustSee.title: The Godfather
mustSee.overview: Spanning the years 1945 to 1955, a chronicle of the fictional Italian-American Corleone crime family.

topRated.title: Civil War
topRated.overview: A team of military-embedded journalists races against time to reach Washington, D.C.

mustSee.title: The Shining
mustSee.overview: Jack Torrance accepts a caretaker job at the Overlook Hotel, where he, his wife Wendy and their son Danny will be isolated for the winter.

mustSee.title: Get Out
mustSee.overview: Chris and his girlfriend Rose go upstate to visit her parents in their weekend getaway. At first, Chris reads the family's overly accommodating behavior as nervous attempts to deal with their daughter's interracial relationship.

topRated.title: A Quiet Place: Day One
topRated.overview: Experience the day the world went silent.

mustSee.title: Interstellar
mustSee.overview: The adventures of a group of explorers who make use of a newly discovered wormhole to surpass the limitations on human space travel.

mustSee.title: The Matrix
mustSee.overview: Set in the 22nd century, The Matrix tells the story of a computer hacker who joins a group of underground insurgents fighting the vast and powerful computers.

topRated.overview: Follow the mythic journey of Paul Atreides as he unites with Chani and the Fremen.
